### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=150 check=False
set -u
body_file=$(mktemp)
cleanup() {
  test ! -e "$body_file" || unlink "$body_file"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
result=$(printf '%s' '{"model":"example-model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with OK. It'"'"'s \"$(true)\"; `x`"}],"max_tokens":16,"temperature":0}' | curl -sS -o "$body_file" \
  -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}' --max-time 120 \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- \
  http://192.0.2.10:11434/v1/chat/completions 2>/dev/null || true)
printf '%s\n' "RESULT=$result" \
  "BODY_B64=$(head -c 65536 "$body_file" | base64 -w0)"
### end
